mod.name: Probably Automated
mod.note: Early menu/gunsmith captures used development candidates at 0.2.5; later captures used 0.2.6 candidates. Final fixes are regression-tested; this is not a single immutable-build full-day run.

method: Official C# MCP client -> stdio PSMcp.Server -> authenticated local bridge -> native Unity actions. Fresh snapshots and UUIDs. State and visible UI verified after dispatch. Developer tools remained disabled. No game/save values were edited.

professionCatalog.name: 水产养殖户
text: 初始拥有一批罗非鱼和鱼食
在跟随导师学习期间，你学会了用水缸养鱼，获取鱼肉。开局时，你会拥有一套小型循环水养殖系统和一批入门鱼种。

professionCatalog.name: 养鼠人
text: 令导师感到恼火的是，你偏偏对动物养殖情有独钟——准确点说，是老鼠养殖。你已经掌握了饲养肉用鼠的基础知识。

professionCatalog.name: 化学家
text: 此专精无法游玩开场部分。
在跟随导师训练期间，你培养出了对麻醉品的敏锐嗅觉。你是不法药物交易的专家，深知这类成瘾性管制品有多暴利。货源吃紧的话，你在实验室里亲自调配的手艺也相当不赖。

professionCatalog.name: 枪械匠
text: 初始拥有一批弹药库存
初始拥有一批枪械与枪械模组库存
此专精无法游玩开场部分。
在跟随导师训练期间，你对枪械和弹药展现出了浓厚的兴趣。你学会了如何改装武器，从自制手枪到威力巨大的机枪都不在话下。如今，手握许可证的你可以承接定制订单，通过给空间站的居民提供武装来赚取稳定的收入。

professionCatalog.name: 水培农场主
text: 初始拥有一批农用物资和种子库存
在跟随导师训练期间，你钻研了水培农作的知识。对于寸土寸金的空间站而言，这是高效种植作物的实用方法。凭借你的专业技能，你不仅能为下层区提供口粮，还能顺手大赚一笔。

professionCatalog.name: 一贫如洗
text: 此专精无法游玩开场部分。
除了替你跟房东谈妥租约，导师没有给你提供任何帮助。除了这家店铺和求生的意志，你一无所有。

professionCatalog.name: 销赃人
text: 初始解锁“清道夫地下交易所”的访问权限
初始拥有一批违禁品库存
此专精无法游玩开场部分。
在跟随导师训练期间，你对违禁品产生了格外的兴趣。你现在是一名资深的黑市商人，甚至在店里安装了暗格，以躲避空间站治安部的搜查。

professionCatalog.name: 水商
text: 额外存储空间（储水容器）
在跟随导师训练期间，你对水资源交易产生了浓厚兴趣。在这个空间站里，净水是稀缺资源。谁能控制水源，谁就能大发横财。

professionCatalog.name: 学徒
text: 初始拥有一批日用品与食物库存
在跟随导师训练期间，你并未对某项特定专精产生浓厚兴趣。相对地，你把心思都用在了精打细算上，从而在盘下店铺时节省了一笔启动资金。

professionCatalog.name: 废料客
text: 在导师找到你之前，你是一名拾荒客，虽一贫如洗但口碑可靠。纵然学了新本事，你依旧不忘老本行，还将当年的旧行头翻新改装后用在了如今的行当上。

professionCatalog.name: 街头小吃摊贩
text: 初始拥有一批食材库存
在跟随导师训练期间，你对烹饪和街头小吃倾注了极大的热情。你对下层区居民的口味了如指掌，随手就能端出便宜好吃的快餐。经营路边摊是一种普遍且灵活的谋生手段，只要食材选得对，利润也相当可观。

professionCatalog.name: 器官贩子
text: 额外设备（器官冷藏容器）
在跟随导师训练期间，你不知不觉迷上了人体器官交易这门阴森的生意。虽然交易那些来源合规、具备证明的器官并不犯法……但从活体病人身上摘取的黑市脏器，利润要丰厚得多。

corrections.resolution: Native use turns the strip into 水质检测试纸（已使用） with the same reference; the expected deletion was wrong. Water testing and purification changed visible results.

corrections.case: hydroponic ration unpacked by native select
corrections.resolution: Selecting a water pack does not unpack it. Drain the existing full bottle, then use the pack on that newly legal target; the pack is consumed.

corrections.case: rat butcher transforms animal / rat butcher produces meat
corrections.resolution: Native blade use is two-step. First use kills the animal and removes it from serum targets; second use produces raw meat. Both steps passed.

fixedDefects.problem: New-game cards were omitted because they reuse WildNetworkSlot outside the upgrade UI.
fixedDefects.fix: Describe native profession/difficulty/perk cards and checkboxes; execute native pointer enter/click/exit. Use menu perk catalog without creating PlayerStore.

fixedDefects.problem: No semantic native Back action in the store.
fixedDefects.fix: navigate_back resolves the native topmost window/selection and pause menu under allowed UI conditions.

fixedDefects.problem: Returning from a run left stale native window references and could make observation fail.
fixedDefects.fix: Detect the main-menu controller and check Unity window-handler validity before IsVisible.

fixedDefects.problem: Machine inventories did not expose their visible panel names.
fixedDefects.fix: Add containers[].label from the visible MachineryPanel heading or slot tooltip. Icon-only panels can have an empty label.

limitations: No full open/trade/close/sleep rerun for the renamed package in this session.
No overnight crop growth, animal breeding, fish hatching, or 3D-print completion asserted.
Chemist test covered manual, coffee-bean blender processing, liquid transfer dispatch, container retrieval and heater high/off; not all recipes.
Serum callback dispatched; animal immunity/remaining uses were not independently quantified.
Three coming-soon professions could be viewed but could not continue. No unlock bypass.
No claim that every item/trait/difficulty/resolution/game version was tested.
